tagline: Global agricultural commodities and agribusiness company
hero_kpi_rationale: Capital expenditures reflect Bunge's commitment to strategic investment in infrastructure, with a 25% increase in 2025 and projections of $1.5 to $1.7 billion for 2026 aimed at supporting growth in oilseeds, biofuels, and plant-based proteins

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments in assets and growth projects
kpis.description: Investments are intended to maintain the cash-generating capacity of assets and fund growth projects, including acquisitions such as Viterra
kpis.signal: Significant increase in investments in assets and growth projects

kpis.name: Short-Term Debt
kpis.description: Short-term debt represents principal repayment obligations due in 2026 and is funded through ongoing operations and cash management
kpis.signal: High level of short-term debt representing 2026 obligations

kpis.name: Planned Investments 2026
kpis.description: Planned investments for 2026 are intended to maintain the cash-generating capacity of assets and fund discretionary and non-discretionary projects, particularly in strengthening the oilseed platform, participation in biofuels, and plant-based proteins
kpis.signal: Maintenance of investment levels to support growth projects

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT systems risks
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions the responsibility of the CTO and CRO in managing cybersecurity risks and regular reporting to the audit committee. The language intensity is moderate but the topic is central to governance. This risk is a constant concern for technology-intensive companies.

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.score_rationale: The company acknowledges being subject to various legal proceedings, including government investigations. Although management does not expect a material impact, it highlights uncertainty regarding final outcomes and the possibility of negative effects.

risks.title: Operational risks related to industrial facilities
risks.score_rationale: The document details a large number of production, refining, and storage facilities worldwide. While facilities are considered adequate, their number and geographic dispersion imply inherent operational risks.

risks.title: Swiss tax risks related to share distributions
risks.score_rationale: The text details Swiss taxation on dividends and share buybacks, including a 35% withholding tax in certain cases. Although exemptions are available, complexity and application conditions represent a risk.

risks.title: Share buyback strategy risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has an active and extensive share buyback program. While this may support the stock price, excessive reliance or poor execution could have implications for capital structure.

ai_positioning.summary: Company BG does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
